description: This source file defines a Java interface 'TimerBuilder' for creating and configuring timer objects with tagging capabilities. It includes method declarations for adding tags, adding individual tags, and building the timer.

classes.name: TimerBuilder
classes.description: A parameterized interface for building Timer instances with support for adding tags and constructing the final Timer object.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer. Existing tags with the same keys will be overridden.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer, overriding existing value if key exists.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Timer object based on the configured tags.
